description_en: Updates the business metadata for a data table in the data map. You can update only the table's Readme and custom attributes
description_zh: 更新数据地图数据表的业务元数据，当前仅支持更新表的使用说明和自定义属性
name: UpdateTableBusinessMetadata

parameters.help_en: The table ID. For the required format, see the response of the `ListTables` operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据表ID，格式可参考ListTables接口返回结果
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The Readme of the table, which supports rich text format
parameters.help_zh: 使用说明，支持富文本格式
parameters.name: readme

parameters.help_en: The values of custom attributes. The key specifies the identifier of a custom attribute, and the value is an array that can contain at most one item. To delete the value for an attribute, pass an empty array. To update only custom attributes, omit the `Readme` parameter to prevent its existing value from being cleared. To leave the custom attributes unchanged, pass an empty object `{}`
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value最多一个值；空列表表示删除该属性值。不传Readme时传入本参数可避免清空使用说明；传空对象表示不更新自定义属性
parameters.name: custom_attributes
